_comment: Each decoder turns {in} (a .frames.jsonl of IMBE frames) into {out}, 8 kHz mono, as a WAV ("output": "wav") or raw 16-bit samples ("s16"). Placeholders: {in} {out} {trunk_pro} {harness} {python} {here}. "needs" names what must be available; decoders whose needs are missing are skipped. Order is the order on the listening page; "default": false leaves a decoder out unless --decoders names it.

trunk-pro.label: Trunk Recorder Pro, enhanced
trunk-pro.note: trunk-pro's enhanced profile: Trunk Recorder's float synthesis rebuilt in Rust, with soft-decision FEC repeat thresholds.

trunk-pro-fixed.label: Trunk Recorder Pro, fixed-point
trunk-pro-fixed.note: trunk-pro's fixed-point profile (its default since October 2026): a Rust port of Pavel Yazev's decoder, sample-identical to TR fixed-point with the same thresholds.

tr-float.label: TR float
tr-float.note: Trunk Recorder's float decoder (softVocoder: true) with its September 2026 synthesis changes, default settings.

tr-fixed.label: TR fixed-point
tr-fixed.note: Pavel Yazev's 2009 fixed-point port of the TIA reference decoder; stock Trunk Recorder's default (softVocoder: false).

mbelib.label: mbelib
mbelib.note: The classic open decoder behind DSD and older tools (trunk-pro's mbelib profile).

blip25.label: blip25
blip25.note: blip25-mbe, an MIT-licensed Rust decoder that follows the IMBE spec with no post-processing.

tr-air.label: TR float + air
tr-air.note: TR float with up to half of each voiced harmonic above 2 kHz rendered as noise (aper_max 0.5), for over-voiced encoders.

tr-stock.label: TR float, stock synthesis
tr-stock.note: TR float with the September synthesis changes turned off: linear phase, TIA interpolation and unvoiced noise, no presence lift.
